title: Syracuse schools paid out-of-town administrator at least $59k on her way out
summary: Syracuse City School District paid a former chief academic officer at least $59,900 as a severance settlement, with a non-disclosure agreement preventing public discussion of the separation. This represents a significant one-time personnel expenditure that raises questions about district spending practices and transparency in executive separations.
